image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features a beige background with red and black text in both English and Chinese. It is organized into sections such as 'Chicken', 'Beef', and 'Pork', each accompanied by small, rectangular photographs of the corresponding dishes. A pair of wooden chopsticks rests on a black holder in the bottom left foreground, partially obscuring the lower edge of the menu.

artifact_observations.reasoning: While the headers ('CHICKEN', 'BEEF', 'PORK') and prices are legible, the smaller descriptive text lines exhibit character fusion and nonsensical glyph shapes, typical of AI-generated text failing to render fine print correctly.

artifact_observations.location: Food images within the menu grid
artifact_observations.reasoning: The small photos of food dishes appear slightly 'mushy' or painterly compared to the sharpness of the text headers, lacking the crisp detail of real photography, though this could also be due to the low resolution of the source image.

artifact_observations.location: Chopsticks and rest in bottom-left corner
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry of the chopstick rest is slightly ambiguous, and the tips of the chopsticks blend softly into the background/menu edge, suggesting minor structural softness.

focus_areas: Legibility of small print vs. headers
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI-generated menus, headers often look real while body text dissolves into pseudo-language. Verify if the 'texture_anomaly' in food photos is due to AI generation or just image compression. Ensure the chopsticks don't have impossible geometry.
